notes: Nearly the whole admin portal is now in the app. Payroll, salary structures and salary revisions; the cashbook, employee advances, expense claims and travel; documents, assets, projects and tasks; offers and joining, onboarding and confirmations; courses, training, appraisals and performance; shifts and rosters, departments, user accounts, permissions and password resets; surveys, events and the audit log. Around thirty screens that until now needed a laptop, so approving something, paying someone or checking a record no longer means finding a desk. Two things anyone can use: you can send a birthday or work-anniversary wish straight from the home screen, and a petty-cash voucher can now be filed with the bill photographed and attached to it. The rest of the app is unchanged — the same one tap to punch in, and the same screens you already know.
